title: Wynnium
description: This Modpack is to enhance the Game experience on the Wynncraft Server
body:
# 🌌 Wynnium — The Ultimate Wynncraft Experience

Elevate your journey through the provinces of Wynn and Gavel.

**Wynnium** is a meticulously curated performance and enhancement modpack built specifically for the Wynncraft MMORPG server.  
It refines Minecraft into a smooth, immersive, and information-rich MMO client — without altering gameplay or breaking server compatibility.

---

## 🏰 Made for Wynncraft

Standard Minecraft isn’t designed for a massive MMORPG.  
Wynnium bridges that gap by focusing on three core pillars:

> ⚡ **Performance**  
> 🌍 **Immersion**  
> 📊 **Information**

Whether you're questing through Gavel, raiding dungeons, or trading in Detlas — Wynnium ensures your experience feels responsive, beautiful, and optimized.

---

## 🚀 Why Wynnium?

Wynnium enhances your Wynncraft experience with:

- Stable FPS even in crowded cities and raids  
- Advanced quest, map, and stat tracking  
- MMO-friendly UI improvements  
- Shader compatibility without sacrificing performance  
- Fully client-side and server-safe setup  

---

## ✨ Key Features

### ⚡ Butter-Smooth Performance
Powered by Sodium, Lithium, Starlight, and FerriteCore to ensure stable FPS even in crowded areas like Detlas or during intense combat.

### 🧭 Wynn-Specific Enhancements
Includes the best community-made tools (like Wynntils) to track quests, minimaps, objectives, and player stats efficiently. Voices Of Wynn is also included for a great voice over.

### 🌄 Visual Overhaul
Full Iris shader compatibility and visual enhancement mods that respect the Wynncraft aesthetic while making the world feel more alive.

### 🎯 Quality of Life Improvements
Enhanced chat, better HUD elements, smoother animations, and useful UI tweaks designed for MMO gameplay.

---

## 🛠️ What's Inside?

| Category | Featured Mods |
|----------|---------------|
| Core | Wynntils (The heart of the experience) |
| Optimization | Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ScalableLux |
| Visuals | Iris Shaders, Continuity, Camera Overhaul |


---


---

## ⚠️ Recommendations

### 🌤️ Shaders
Wynnium includes Iris.  
For the best “Wynn” atmosphere, we suggest using **BLISS or BSL**.


---

## 📌 Important

> This modpack is a fan-made project and is not officially affiliated with the Wynncraft Team.  
> Always follow the official Wynncraft server rules.

---

## 🌟 Ready to Start Your Adventure?

Download **Wynnium** and experience Wynncraft the refined way.
